bullets.text: Writing and backtesting Java policies that tune upper/lower bounds on EC2 capacity reserved for Amazon Redshift operations like patching, to balance availability against cost
Rebuilt a legacy test-data workflow builder in React/TypeScript + Electron, adding a React-Flow editor and Jest-tested validation; 90% of 30+ surveyed developers preferred it to the old tool
Precomputed a tree-style search index over popular workflows from a 270K+ row PostgreSQL table (Python/SQLAlchemy, Redis cache) to minimize DB queries under access limits
Cut LLM workflow generation time 65% to under 15s by decomposing a Claude skill into sub-skills backed by Python search/validation tools, guided by CloudWatch + OpenSearch latency logs
Shipped a space-research tool used by Amazon Leo's public-policy team, now maintained by Leo engineers; deployed on AWS Fargate (Docker) via GitHub Actions and CDK (TypeScript)
Reduced end-to-end latency 34% for a pipeline routing 6,000+ scraped research documents to inference by replacing S3 staging hops with Kinesis streams feeding Lambda
Automated EventBridge-scheduled fine-tuning of a Bedrock source-relevancy model, with decision gates that skip redundant retraining; added X-Ray tracing and SNS failure alerts
Built a Python pipeline for PhysTwin, a PhD-led digital twin project targeting ICLR: runs AnyGrasp on multi-camera images, renders grasps as Open3D overlays for a VLM; tuned the VLM's prompts
Shortened research-environment setup time 30% with uv dependency pinning and Docker; added psutil time/memory profiling and Pytest suites to find bottlenecks
Co-founded a 110+ member campus product studio that has shipped 5 live products, including Tortuga, a class scheduler with 20,000+ visits in its first 30 days
Added Redis query caching over Tortuga's Prisma SQL queries to reduce database load and application latency
Building a RAG meal-suggestion feature for the official UMD app (GPT-4o mini, ChromaDB + SentenceBERT search); 93% of generated meals rated satisfactory by internal testers
Engineered a C++17 order book and matching engine that replayed 50.9M real IEX DEEP+ messages with no resync, matching 99,122 of 99,123 fills exactly and 100% of top-of-book prices
Benchmarked B+ tree vs LSM skip-list stores for the simulation's event logs on identical 2M-record workloads; the B+ tree gave 12.8 read throughput and 22 faster range summaries for 27% more disk
Sustained 1.26M events/sec end-to-end over the full replay, with 686.7 ns/event in the matching engine
